title: &aHearth and Harvest
subtitle: Farmer's Delight: crops, the cooking pot and feasts for the party.

quests.title: Crops of the Wild
desc: &eFarmer's Delight&r adds four crops: &acabbage&r, &ctomato&r, &6onion&r and &frice&r. They grow wild across many biomes (fields, beaches, swamps, riverbanks).
Break the wild plants for seeds, or check village chests.

quests.title: A Cook's Knife
desc: Knives are the cook's tool. Kill animals with one for extra cuts (ham, bacon), and use it on tall grass to gather &eStraw&r.
Start with flint; upgrade to iron, gold, diamond or netherite later.

quests.title: The Cutting Board
desc: Place an ingredient on a &eCutting Board&r and right-click it with a knife to slice it: cabbage leaves, raw pasta, sliced meat. Other tools work too: an axe strips logs, a pickaxe breaks bricks.
Many pot recipes need ingredients cut first, so keep the board next to your stove.

quests.title: The Skillet
desc: Put a &eSkillet&r on a campfire or stove and right-click raw food onto it to cook it quickly.
It's also a heavy, clanging weapon in a pinch.

quests.title: Soup's On
quests.subtitle: The Cooking Pot
desc: The &eCooking Pot&r is the heart of the kitchen. Set it over heat (campfire, fire, magma or a Stove), put in up to six ingredients and a bowl, and it cooks a meal.
Cook a &eBeef Stew&r. JEI (press &eU&r on the pot) lists every pot recipe.

quests.title: A Proper Kitchen
desc: A &eStove&r is a tidy heat source: put the pot or skillet on top, or cook six things at once on its own surface.
Build a kitchen near your base's waystone. Your party will thank you before every boss.

quests.title: Nourishment and Comfort
desc: Hearty meals give &eNourishment&r: your food bar stops dropping (except while you heal). Soups and stews give &eComfort&r: you regenerate however hungry you are.
Eat one before a long dungeon. AppleSkin shows how much each meal restores.

quests.title: A Feast for the Party
desc: Some meals are too big for one person. &eFeasts&r (Roast Chicken, Stuffed Pumpkin, Honey Glazed Ham, Shepherd's Pie) are placed as blocks.
Right-click a feast with a bowl to serve a portion. One feast feeds the whole party before a boss fight.

quests.title: Rice Paddies
desc: Plant &erice&r in a shallow puddle, one block of water deep. It grows up out of the water and gives rice panicles (and straw).
Rice is in many good meals: fried rice, cabbage rolls, stuffed pumpkin.

quests.title: Rich Soil
desc: Craft &eOrganic Compost&r and place it: it slowly decays into &eRich Soil&r. Crops on Rich Soil farmland grow faster.
Plant a red or brown mushroom on Rich Soil and it becomes a &eMushroom Colony&r you can harvest again and again.

quests.title: Tomatoes on a Rope
desc: Tomato vines climb &eRope&r. Hang rope above a tomato plant and it keeps growing upward, giving more tomatoes from the same spot.
Optional, but tomato sauce goes into a lot of recipes.

quests.title: Let the Machines Farm
desc: A Create &eMechanical Harvester&r on a moving contraption (a piston, bearing or cart) cuts ripe crops and replants them as it passes.
Add a belt or chute to collect the harvest. See the Create chapter for the basics.

quests.title: Master Chef
desc: Eat a course of every meal Farmer's Delight can make. It takes every crop, every pot recipe and a few feasts.
A well-fed party is a party that survives the Blood Moon.
